citations.quote: She played a key role in advancing AB 2353, a law that removes costly delays in the welfare tax exemption process.
citations.locator: Cutting Red Tape to Build Housing Faster

notes: The campaign site's own description of her role; the Governor's signing list names Assemblymember Christopher Ward as the author. The State Controller's press release on the bill (sco.ca.gov) is behind a bot challenge and was not read.
